bugs.title: SQL injection via tableName parameter
bugs.description: tableName is interpolated directly into SQL query — attacker-controlled table name enables injection

bugs.title: SQL injection via where and columns in exportCsv
bugs.description: where clause and columns array interpolated into SQL without parameterization

bugs.title: Entire file read into memory synchronously
bugs.description: fs.readFileSync loads entire CSV into memory — fails on large files

bugs.title: Scheduler swallows errors silently
bugs.description: Failed jobs only console.log the error — no retry, no alert, no status tracking

bugs.title: setInterval never cleared — resource leak
bugs.description: Intervals created in processScheduled are never stopped — no cleanup mechanism

bugs.title: Partial import on failure — no transaction
bugs.description: Records inserted one-by-one without transaction — failure mid-import leaves partial data

bugs.title: Floating point arithmetic on currency
bugs.description: Tax calculation uses floating point: 0.1 * 100 can produce rounding errors in financial data

bugs.title: Missing currency rate causes TypeError crash
bugs.description: Accessing rates[currency] when currency not in rates map returns undefined, multiplication = NaN silently corrupts data

bugs.title: mergeCsvFiles reads without encoding spec
bugs.description: readFileSync without explicit encoding returns Buffer — parse may mishandle non-UTF8 files
